BirdWeather

This is the documentation for V1 of the BirdWeather API.

  • Production: https://app.birdweather.com/api/v1

POST parameters can be passed either as a JSON object string (application/json) or as HTML encoded form parameters (application/x-www-form-urlencoded). The examples below will use JSON.

For authenticated requests, the authentication token is passed as the {token} path segment. User endpoints additionally accept it as a JSON or form parameter token, or using the Authorization or X-Auth-Token header.

Administrators may instead authenticate with an administrator API token, obtained from the BirdWeather admin. This token is only read from the Authorization (as Bearer <token>) or X-Auth-Token header — never from the URL or a request parameter. When it is supplied, station endpoints accept a numeric station id in place of the station’s own token, and are not restricted to active stations. An administrator token grants full read and write access to every station, including destructive endpoints, so it should be treated as a password and regenerated in the admin if exposed.

For support, please contact support@birdweather.com.

Station Stats ¶

Station Stats  ¶

These endpoints require authentication with a station auth token.

Fetch Stats
GET/api/v1/stations/{token}/stats{?period,since,mode,classification}

Example URI

GET /api/v1/stations/token/stats?period=week&since=2023-06-18&mode=live&classification=avian
URI Parameters
HideShow
token
string (required) 

Station authentication token

period
string (optional) Example: week

The time period to filter detections [day / week / month / all] (default: day).

since
string (optional) Example: 2023-06-18

Timestamp to filter detections from, in ISO8601 format. Overrides period if passed.

mode
string (optional) Example: live

Limit results to detections with the given soundscape mode [live / recorded / birdnetpi].

classification
string (optional) Example: avian

Limit results to species with the given classification, or a comma-separated list of classifications (e.g. bat,mammal) [avian / amphibian / reptile / mammal / bat / insect].

Response  200
HideShow
Headers
Content-Type: application/json
Body
{
  "success": true,
  "detections": 12345,
  "species": 99
}

Station Species ¶

Station Species  ¶

These endpoints require authentication with a station auth token.

Top Species
GET/api/v1/stations/{token}/species{?period,from,to,since,limit,page,sort,order,speciesId,query,mode,locale,classification}

Returns a list of species detected by the station, along with their detection counts.

By default it will return the top species by detection count, but can be reordered by species common or scientific name.

Example URI

GET /api/v1/stations/token/species?period=week&from=2023-06-18&to=2023-06-20&since=2023-06-18&limit=10&page=2&sort=common_name&order=desc&speciesId=305&query=magpie&mode=live&locale=es&classification=avian
URI Parameters
HideShow
token
string (required) 

Station authentication token

period
string (optional) Example: week

The time period to filter detections [day / week / month / all] (default: day).

from
string (optional) Example: 2023-06-18

Timestamp to filter detections from, in ISO8601 format. Overrides period if passed.

to
string (optional) Example: 2023-06-20

Timestamp to filter detections to, in ISO8601 format. Overrides period if passed.

since
string (optional) Example: 2023-06-18

Alias for from parameter. Overrides period if passed.

limit
integer (optional) Example: 10

The maximum number of species to return (max 100, default: 100).

page
integer (optional) Example: 2

The page number of species to return (default: 1).

sort
string (optional) Example: common_name

Alternative field to sort by [common_name / scientific_name / top] (default: top).

order
string (optional) Example: desc

Sort order [asc / desc] (default: asc when sorting by name, otherwise desc).

speciesId
integer (optional) Example: 305

Limit results to the given species.

query
string (optional) Example: magpie

Limit results to species that match the given query (will be ignored if speciesId is provided).

mode
string (optional) Example: live

Limit results to detections with the given soundscape mode [live / recorded / birdnetpi].

locale
string (optional) Example: es

Language locale to use for search query.

classification
string (optional) Example: avian

Limit results to species with the given classification, or a comma-separated list of classifications (e.g. bat,mammal) [avian / amphibian / reptile / mammal / bat / insect].

Detections ¶

Detections  ¶

These endpoints require authentication with a station auth token.

Post Detection
POST/api/v1/stations/{token}/detections

Registers a detection that has previously been analyzed by BirdNET or a compatible soundscape analyzer.

  • timestamp (string, required) - The timestamp of the start of the detection, in ISO8601 format.

  • commonName (string, required) - The species’ common name.

  • scientificName (string, required) - The species’ scientific name.

  • lat (float) - Latitude for the detection (will use the station’s latitude if not specified).

  • lon (float) - Longitude for the detection (will use the station’s longitude if not specified).

  • confidence (float) - Confidence as detected by BirdNET.

  • soundscapeId (integer) - ID of a previously uploaded soundscape.

  • soundscapeStartTime (float) - Start time (in seconds) of the detection within the soundscape audio file.

  • soundscapeEndTime (float) - End time (in seconds) of the detection within the soundscape audio file.

Example URI

POST /api/v1/stations/token/detections

string (required)

List Detections
GET/api/v1/stations/{token}/detections{?limit,cursor,from,to,speciesId,query,mode,locale,classification,behavior,shortlist}

Lists all detections associated with this station in timestamp descending order. When the detections result is empty, a fallback list (unfiltered_detections) is included.

Parameters should be provided as query parameters. Pagination is cursor-based using limit/offset params.

Example URI

GET /api/v1/stations/token/detections?limit=10&cursor=12345&from=2023-06-18&to=2023-07-05&speciesId=305&query=magpie&mode=live&locale=es&classification=avian&behavior=bat_chase&shortlist=true
URI Parameters
HideShow
token
string (required) 

Station authentication token.

limit
integer (optional) Example: 10

The maximum number of detections to return (max 100, default: 100).

cursor
integer (optional) Example: 12345

The ID of the last detection to begin pagination from.

from
string (optional) Example: 2023-06-18

The timestamp in ISO8601 format to filter detections from (inclusive).

to
string (optional) Example: 2023-07-05

The timestamp in ISO8601 format to filter detections to (inclusive).

speciesId
integer (optional) Example: 305

List only detections for the given species.

query
string (optional) Example: magpie

Limit results to species that match the given query (will be ignored if speciesId is provided).

mode
string (optional) Example: live

Limit results to detections with the given soundscape mode [live / recorded / birdnetpi].

locale
string (optional) Example: es

Language locale to use for search query.

classification
string (optional) Example: avian

Limit results to species with the given classification, or a comma-separated list of classifications (e.g. bat,mammal) [avian / amphibian / reptile / mammal / bat / insect].

behavior
string (optional) Example: bat_chase

Limit results to detections with the given bat behavior, or a comma-separated list (e.g. bat_chase,bat_feeding_buzz) [bat_search_open / bat_search_clutter / bat_chase / bat_feeding_buzz / bat_approach / bat_pass / bat_social]. bat_approach also matches bat_chase.

shortlist
boolean (optional) Example: true

Include the species shortlist for each detection that has one (default: false). Only honoured for stations on the bat edition; ignored for every other station, including standard_bat beta units. See Detection Info for the shortlist format.

Response  200
HideShow
Headers
Content-Type: application/json
Body

    "success": true,
    "detections": [
        {
            ...
        },
        {
            ...
        }
    ]
}
Response  200
HideShow
Headers
Content-Type: application/json
Body
{
    "success": true,
    "detections": [],
    "unfiltered_detections": [
        {

}

Detection  ¶

These endpoints require authentication with a station auth token.

Detection Info
GET/api/v1/stations/{token}/detections/{id}

Retrieves information for the detection with the given ID.

Bat detections additionally include a behavior field (a human-readable label, e.g. Chase), a behavior_key field (the machine key, one of bat_search_open, bat_search_clutter, bat_chase, bat_feeding_buzz, bat_approach, bat_pass, bat_social), and a behavior_confidence float (0…1). These fields are omitted from the response when no behavior classification is available.

When the detection has a shortlist, the response includes a shortlist array, ranked by weight descending. Each entry is an alternative candidate species the analyzer considered for the detection, with speciesId, commonName, scientificName, and a normalized weight (0…1). The field is omitted for detections without a shortlist, and is served only for stations on the bat edition – standard_bat beta units are capped to the bat identification rung and never expose the candidates behind that commit.

Example URI

GET /api/v1/stations/token/detections/57299468
URI Parameters
HideShow
token
string (required) 

Station authentication token

id
integer (required) Example: 57299468

Detection ID

Global Detection  ¶

Detection Info
GET/api/v1/detections/{id}

Retrieves information for the detection with the given ID, regardless of which station recorded it. No authentication is required.

The response is identical to the station-scoped endpoint above, including behavior and shortlist where available.

Detections recorded before May 2025 are not served by this endpoint; request them through the station-scoped endpoint instead.

Example URI

GET /api/v1/detections/57299468

id
integer (required) Example: 57299468

Soundscapes ¶

Soundscapes  ¶

These endpoints require authentication with a station auth token.

Upload Soundscape
POST/api/v1/stations/{token}/soundscapes{?timestamp}

Uploads an audio file which can then be associated with a posted detection.

The audio file should be submitted as the POST body with the timestamp specified as a query parameter in the URL in ISO8601 format.

Example URI

POST /api/v1/stations/token/soundscapes?timestamp=2022-04-27T23:41:37.212-07:00
URI Parameters
HideShow
token
string (required) 

Station authentication token

timestamp
string (required) Example: 2022-04-27T23:41:37.212-07:00

The timestamp of the start of the soundscape, in ISO8601 format

Response  201
HideShow
Headers
Content-Type: application/json
Body
{
  "success": true,
  "soundscape": {
    "id": 12345,
    "stationId": 1,
    "duration": 3,
    "filesize": 85444,
    "sampleRate": 48000,
    "timestamp": "2022-04-27T23:41:37.212-07:00",
    "mode": "live",
    "url": "https://media.birdweather.com/soundscapes/4de6d017c348f716959751efdf9e897c"
  }
}

List Soundscapes
GET/api/v1/stations/{token}/soundscapes

Lists all soundscapes associated with this station in timestamp descending order.

Parameters should be provided as query parameters. Pagination is cursor-based using limit/offset params.

Example URI

Station Configuration ¶

Station Configuration  ¶

Update Station Config
POST/api/v1/stations/{token}/config

Updates the configuration for the given station.

  • name (string) - The new name for the station.

  • locationPrivacy (boolean) - Toggle location privacy.

  • minConfidence (float) - Set minimum confidence for a valid detection (0.35 … 1.0).

  • minProbability (float) - Set minimum probability for a valid detection (0.0 … 1.0).

  • minScore (float) - Set minimum score for a valid detection (0.0 … 10.0).

  • minHumanConfidence (float) - Set minimum confidence for flagging human detections (0.01 … 0.25) [default: 0.04]. A lower value is more sensitive and will result in more soundscapes being auto-purged.

Example URI

POST /api/v1/stations/token/config
